spans.s: cl. 2. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiv, 15) निंस्ते, Bhaṭṭ. (निंसते, निंसत and p. निं॑सान, RV.; निंस्से, निंस्स्व, Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 3, 58; pf. निनिंसे aor. अनिंसिष्ट fut. निंसिष्यते, निंसिता, Gr.) to touch closely, kiss, salute. (Perhaps fr. निनंस्, Desid. of √ नम्, like लिप्स् fr. लि-लप्स् cf. √ निक्ष्.)
touching, kissing (ifc.; cf. नेत्र-).
(Desid. of √ 2. नश्), wishing to perish or die, Bhaṭṭ.

नि-√ नद् P. -नदति, to sound, cry out, resound, MBh.; R. &c.:
Caus. -नादयति, to cause to sound or resound, fill with noise or cries &c., ib.
नि-˚नद m. (n., ChUp. iii, 13, 8) sound, noise, crying, humming, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
नि-˚नाद m. sound, noise, crying, humming, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
नि-˚नादित mfn. filled with noise, resonant with (instr.), ib.
नि-˚नादित n. = prec. ib.
नि-˚नादिन् mfn. sounding, resounding, crying, resonant with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
ifc. causing to sound, playing (a musical instrument), MBh.; Hariv.
fastened on, tied to (loc.), RV. vi, 75, 5.
(or नि-नाह्य᳙), m. a water-jar put into the ground, ŚBr.
˚यनीय. See नि-नी below.
नि-˚नयन n. pouring down or out, Kauś. (cf. स्वधा-न्˚)
carrying out, performance, MW.
w.r. for निवृत्त-श्˚.
desire of dancing, Hcar.

नि-√ नर्द् P. -नर्दति, to sound, prolong a note in chanting, slur or trill, ṢaḍvBr. (cf. अव-√ नर्द्) :
Caus. -नर्दयति, GopBr.
a slur or trill, ĀśvŚr.
See under √ निन्द्.
wishing to blame, RV.
नि-˚नयनीय See स्वधा-निनयनीय.
, desire of bringing or carrying or taking away, MBh.
निनी˚षु mfn. wishing to take or carry or bring or lead to (acc. or acc. with प्रति) or spend (time), MBh.; Kād.; Rājat.
नि-√ नृत् P. -नृत्यति, to repeat (lit. dance again) a portion of a verse or syllable, ŚāṅkhBr.
नि-˚नृत्त mfn. repeated (as above), AitBr.
नि-˚नृत्त—वत् mfn. having repetition, ib.
नि-˚नृत्ति f. repetition, ŚāṅkhBr.

or निद् cl. 1. P. नि॑न्दति, ep. also ˚ते (the form निद् only in 3. pl. pf. निनिदु॑स्, in the Desid. and in some deriv. See under 1. निद् and निनित्सु॑ below; pf. निनिन्द, MBh.; aor. अ॑निन्दिषुर्, RV.; नि॑न्दिषत्, AV.; Pot. निन्द्यात्, Up.; fut. निन्दिष्यति, Vop.; निन्दिता, MBh.; ind.p. -निन्द्य, ib.),
to blame, censure, revile, despise, ridicule, RV. &c. &c.:
Desid. नि॑नित्सति, ˚ते, to wish to blame &c., RV.; ĀśvŚr. [cf. Gk. ὄ-νειδος.]
only in -तल
blame, censure, reproach, reviling, defamation, controversy, injury, outrage, AV.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(with, Buddh.) one of the eight worldly conditions, Dharmas. lxi
निन्द—तल mfn. = निन्दित-हस्त, having a maimed hand, L. (also निम्न-त्˚, W.)
blaming, abusive, censorious
(mostly ifc.) a blamer or scorner (cf. ब्राह्मण-, वेद-), Mn.; MBh. &c.
निन्˚दन n. reproach, censure, blame, Pāṇ.
blamable, reprehensible, Hariv.
निन्दा—स्तुति f. ironical praise, irony, L.
निन्˚दोपमा f. a comparison which involves reproof, Kāvyād. ii, 30.
blamed, censured, abused, defamed, low, despicable, prohibited, forbidden, RV.; Br. &c.
N. of a man, RV. viii, 1, 30.
scorner, scoffer, RV.
blaming, censuring, reproaching (ifc.), Kāvyād.
a woman bearing a dead child, L.
निन्द्य᳙ (or नि॑न्द्य), mfn. = ˚दनीय, RV.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
निन्द्य—ता f. blamableness, disgrace, Mn.
the entrance into which is faulty, Daś.
cl. 1. ˚वति (Dhātup. xv, 81; v.l. सिन्व्), to wet or to attend (prob. a confusion between सेचने and सेवने).
नी—नाह॑ m. (√ नह्) a girth, AV.
